results.content:
Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up.

results.content:
Trump has a 45% approval rating in Mississippi, according to Aug. 31 polling data from Civiqs. That's the lowest ever for the state.

His disapproval rating is 49%, which is also the highest for both terms. About 6% neither approve nor disapprove.

Trump started this term in 2025 with about a 56% approval rating in the Magnolia State. About 41% disapproved. Both groups basically mirrored each other for most of his second term, inching closer and closer together over time. [...] The state gave Trump an approval rating ranging from 52% to 56% in his first term, according to Civiqs. The disapproval rating ranged from about 41% to 45%.

## What do major polls say about Trump's approval rating?
results.title: Trump approval rating falls to new low in Mississippi, US polls

results.content:
AP News' poll from the Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research says Trump's approval rating stands at 66% against and 33% for him as of July 23.
 Fox News' poll says Trump stands at 61% against and 39% for as of July 17-20.
 Reuters/Ipsos' poll says Trump stands at 63% disapproval, 33% approval as of Aug. 28-31.
 Civiqs' national polling says Trump stands at 59% against and 36% for with 6% undecided as of Aug. 31.
